summary.business_type: Consumer web app with paid listings (birthday leaderboard)
top_findings: Every page is sent no-store: nothing can be cached on the CDN
No page answers 'famous birthdays today' (homepage has no famous people)
'Age 48' is the age at the board's next date and reads as wrong today
404 pages have an empty server-rendered body
Date pages are 37% unique on the strict measure; no holiday context
quick_wins: One sentence with sign, birthstone and flower on date pages
dateModified in JSON-LD from the sitemap's lastmod
Remove X-Powered-By; share image for Terms and Privacy

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fully server-rendered; valid robots.txt; single-hop redirects
Five security headers on every response

findings.title: Every page is sent no-store
findings.description: All public pages answer Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, so a CDN can't cache anything.
findings.recommendation: Static/ISR for content pages; short revalidate plus revalidateTag from the Stripe webhook for boards.

findings.title: 404 body is empty without JavaScript
findings.description: Right status and noindex, but no message, links or lang in the HTML.

findings.title: About 240 KB gzipped JS/CSS on every page
findings.description: Radix UI loads on content-only pages such as Terms.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load the Boost, Share and Gift menus and the date picker.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Facts verified by script on all 366 date pages: 0 errors
Cited commonness rank on every date page

findings.title: Age label reads as wrong today
findings.description: The number is the age the person turns on the board's next date.

findings.title: No holiday or observance context
findings.description: /december-25 never mentions Christmas; strict uniqueness is 37%.
findings.recommendation: A small holidays table feeding the About paragraph (client OK, 07 D9).

findings.title: Placeholders on legal pages
findings.description: '[Launch date]' and '[If required: ... Article 27 GDPR.]' are visible.
findings.recommendation: Client fills them in or edits them in the admin.

findings.title: Famous-people data bugs
findings.description: Adult performers, duplicate dates, 'footballer' labels, cut-off labels and February's rarest date.
findings.recommendation: Fixed during the audit with tests; data refreshed.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles (45-58 chars) and descriptions (123-159) on all 382 pages
One H1 per page, no skipped heading levels
Every date page is 3 clicks from anywhere

findings.title: Date page H1 has no 'birthday'
findings.description: 'Everyone celebrating October 7' is the client's mockup copy.
findings.recommendation: Leave as is; the title carries the keyword.

findings.title: Famous list is the third block on date pages
findings.description: On unclaimed boards the H1 is followed by nobody.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD on every template; 5,490 Person nodes linked to Wikidata
BreadcrumbList on all date and month pages

findings.title: No dateModified
findings.description: WebPage and CollectionPage nodes carry no dateModified.

findings.title: No breadcrumbs on How it works, Terms, Privacy
findings.description: Those pages have no BreadcrumbList or WebPage node.
findings.recommendation: Add them; JSON-LD is in findings/schema.md.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: No third-party scripts; no images to load

findings.title: Simulated mobile LCP 2.9-3.0 s
findings.description: Over the 2.5 s limit; caused by render-blocking CSS and the 77 KB font, not the server.
findings.recommendation: Shrink shared CSS; confirm with field data after launch.

findings.title: Every page is sent no-store
findings.description: All public pages answer Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, so a CDN can't cache anything.
findings.recommendation: Static/ISR for content pages; short revalidate plus revalidateTag from the Stripe webhook for boards.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed and served full HTML

findings.title: Sign, birthstone and flower only in fact cards
findings.description: Text extractors drop them on date pages.
findings.recommendation: One sentence in the About paragraph.

findings.title: No freshness signal
findings.description: Extractors guessed 2026-01-01 from the footer year.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No content images, so no alt-text or CLS issues
Share image on every date, month and personal page

findings.title: Terms and Privacy have no share image

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Make pages cacheable (ISR + revalidateTag from the Stripe webhook)
Backfill famous people for all 12 months on production

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Lazy-load menus and the date picker
Remove X-Powered-By; share image for legal pages; stable WebSite description

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: 'Famous birthdays today' strip on the homepage

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Submit the sitemap; watch 'Crawled - currently not indexed' for 2-4 weeks
Connect Search Console and CrUX data
